phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F4 Phase A — Loans Coverage Audit

directly_resolved_topology.interpretation: Direct QSA asset-side coverage is strong for H/C/G holders and their H/C/G/X counterparties. Missing coverage is concentrated in cells involving the composite financial sector F, BNR, and rest-of-world holders.

interpretation: BNR has a small constant aggregate F4 asset position of 6.1 million RON through 2025 and zero aggregate F4 liabilities.

For stock only, a zero aggregate liability position combined with the non-negative nature of loan positions is a candidate exact structural-zero constraint for the BNR issuer column; this must be preregistered and tested in a separate gate before use.
Zero aggregate transactions do not by themselves prove every bilateral BNR flow is zero because offsetting transactions are possible; no flow cell is inferred from this aggregate.

scientific_interpretation: No maturity inconsistency was detected among published T/S/L representations.
The unavailable liability-side mirrors are not treated as zeros; asset-side observations remain the preferred direct representation where present.
The F = S12 - S121 identity is blocked cell-by-cell primarily because the S121 counterpart detail is not disseminated, even where the corresponding S12 asset-side series exists.
The existence of complete W0 row/column controls means a later algebraic-complement gate can test whether missing stock cells are uniquely identifiable without synthetic allocation.
